name: fetch-object
title: Fetch an object to a receptacle
description: Bring one object to a support or container: the robot goes to the object, picks it up, carries it to the receptacle and puts it there.
use_when: One object must be brought to a destination (navigate, pick, carry, place in one node).

not_to_be_confused_with.restore: restore's destination is the object's starting support.
not_to_be_confused_with.collect: collect moves a list into one container.
not_to_be_confused_with.pick: fetch also carries and places the object.

applicability.summary: Requires hand_empty(hand=right). Some bound nouns add preconditions (see Conditions that depend on the bound nouns).

preconditions.meaning: No lid rests on the container rim.

postconditions.meaning: Object centre inside the container's wall profile, between its floor and 3 cm above the rim.
Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

arg_formats.receptacle_ref: a support surface or an open container

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
